title: The Future Is Finer: Multivariate Time Series Super-Resolution Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.33470v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web platforms run on multivariate time series, from service telemetry and Web traffic logs to sensor streams served through Web APIs. Yet, retention policies often archive them at coarse granularity to save storage and bandwidth. Decisions such as autoscaling, alerting, and billing operate at finer granularity than existing forecasters reach, since these models predict at the resolution of their input. We therefore introduce Multivariate Time Series Super-Resolution Forecasting (MTS-SRF), which forecasts fine-grained futures from coarse histories, and propose TimeMagnifier to address its three challenges. translated_title: 未来更精细：多变量时间序列超分辨率预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.33470v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：Web平台运行在多变量时间序列之上，从服务遥测数据和Web流量日志到通过Web API提供的传感器流。然而，为了节省存储和带宽，数据保留策略通常以粗粒度归档这些时间序列。自动扩缩容、告警和计费等决策需要在比现有预测模型所能达到的更细粒度上运作，因为这些模型只能以输入数据的分辨率进行预测。因此，我们提出了多变量时间序列超分辨率预测（MTS-SRF），它能够从粗粒度的历史数据预测出细粒度的未来，并提出了TimeMagnifier模型来解决其三大挑战。Fourier Anchor通过将每个输入窗口拟合到带有稀疏跨变量门控的趋势-傅里叶结构来应对数据稀疏性问题；De-noise Only通过沿分辨率轴而非噪声轴进行细化来约束细粒度上的模糊性，并逐级延长网格；带状DTW对齐则校正跨分辨率的错位问题……
tldr: 该论文提出了多变量时间序列超分辨率预测（MTS-SRF）新任务，并设计了TimeMagnifier模型，通过傅里叶锚定、仅去噪细化和带状DTW对齐三项技术，从粗粒度历史序列预测出细粒度的未来序列，解决数据稀疏、细粒度模糊和跨分辨率错位三大挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Multivariate Time Series Super-Resolution Forecasting (MTS-SRF) and proposes TimeMagnifier, which forecasts fine-grained futures from coarse-grained histories by tackling data sparsity, fine-grained ambiguity, and cross-resolution misalignment through Fourier Anchor, De-noise Only, and banded DTW Alignment.
